svg.title: ProClaim Architecture Overview
svg.desc: Three-layer architecture: Presentation Layer (PyQt6), Core Engine (Python), and Data Layer (SQLite + Assets)

g.text: PyQt6 — what the operator sees and interacts with
Pure Python — business logic, state management, rendering
SQLite + local filesystem — all content lives here

svg.text: Stack: Python 3.11+ · PyQt6 · SQLite · Pillow · python-vlc · pywin32
